---
name: Feedback from a data person
about: You work with data and played it — tell me what you saw
title: 'Feedback: '
labels: feedback
---

Answer whatever you have an opinion on and delete the rest. Partial answers are genuinely
useful — one sharp observation beats a filled-in form.

**How far did you get?** (module 1 / module 2 / the judgment tasks / endless mode)

**Do the tasks read like real requests?**
Anything that felt like a textbook exercise rather than something a colleague would send you?

**Difficulty curve**
Where was it too easy, and where did it jump?

**What is missing?**
Which part of your actual work has no equivalent here?

**Judgment tasks (A/B, conclusions, data quality, dashboards)**
These are built so exactly one answer is defensible. Did you disagree with any of them?
If so, which — and why?

**Would you give this to a junior on your team?**
If not, what stops you?

---

**Your background** (optional, helps me weigh the feedback)
Roughly how long have you worked with data, and in what kind of setup?

**Anything broken?**
Browser, and what happened. Console errors are gold if you have them.
